meta.title: Crittenden County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Crittenden County's 2026 approved budget as filed with the state. We used the 2026 column, which the book labels 'Amount Requested'. Each fund total matches the county's own budget totals page.

nodes.name: Retired Employees
nodes.note: No category totals are printed in the 2026 column; only the department total.

nodes.name: Supplies
nodes.note: The printed Supplies total also includes the coroner's 3000-series lines (phones, travel, fleet liability, dues, training).

nodes.name: Other services and charges
nodes.note: Printed only as 'Total'; the one line in it is (3104) Community Assistance, a 3000-series line.

nodes.name: County Road Wholesale Fuel Tax
nodes.note: No grand total line is printed; the fund total is its only category total, and it matches the budget totals page (p. 4).
